Why has the Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankundram become a legal battle?
The dispute over lighting the ceremonial lamp at Deepathoon instead of the customary Uchipillaiyar Deepa Mandapam has reached the Supreme Court.
It explains the historical background, the Madras High Court's orders, the Supreme Court's November 20 direction and why the lamp was not lit at Deepathoon on November 24.
Aditya Edara, a TPSJ alum interning with ThePrint explains
